data.fund_type: An Open-ended Index Exchange Traded Fund.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, closely correspond to the total returns ofthe Securities as represented by the Nifty CPSE Index, by investing in the Securities which are constituents of the Nifty CPSEIndex in the same proportion as in the Index. However the performance of the Scheme may diﬀer from that of underlyingindex due to tracking error. There can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would beachieved
data.asset_allocation: Securities covered by the Nifty CPSE Index - 95% to 100%, Money Market Instruments- 0% to 5% (with maturity not exceeding91 days), including Tri-party repo on G-sec or T-bills, cash & cash equivalents
